Purpose / Required Capability: Create Project: Creates a new project in ProjectFlow workspace under a portfolio, initializing default Kanban columns, settings, and environments.
Create Portfolio: Creates a new Portfolio container in the workspace to group and organize projects.
List All Projects: Lists all projects currently in the workspace with ID, name, portfolio, and status.
List Portfolios: Lists all portfolios available in the workspace.
Archive Project: Archives an active project, moving it to the Archived Projects tab on Project Home.
Restore Project: Restores an archived project back to Active status on Project Home.
Delete Project: Soft-deletes a project, moving it to trash.
Update Portfolio: Updates a portfolio folder name or description on Project Home.
Delete Portfolio: Deletes an empty portfolio folder from Project Home.
Set Primary Project Manager: Assigns or updates the primary Project Manager for a project.
Autogen Turnkey Project: Scaffolds an entire turnkey project with epics, stories, tasks, test cycles, test cases, and RAID items.
Project Home Metrics: Queries summary count cards of total active projects, portfolios, and health distributions.
Clone Project: Clones an existing project structure, settings, columns, and templates into a new project.
Portfolio Health Summary: Retrieves executive RAG health distribution (Red, Amber, Green), high potential risks, and critical issues across the portfolio.
Portfolio Risks: Queries and ranks high-potential risks across all active projects in the portfolio.
Portfolio Issues: Queries open critical and high priority issues/blockers across all active projects.
Filter Dashboard Trends: Filters executive health and defect/risk trends across custom date intervals.
Export Portfolio Summary: Generates executive PDF/CSV portfolio status summary report.
Query Quality Estimations: Queries initial man-days vs planned man-days, variance, actual effort, and conformance rates across projects.
Export Quality Estimations: Exports cross-project estimation accuracy and effort variance data to CSV.
Variance Alert Threshold: Configures threshold percentages to trigger alerts when project planned effort exceeds initial estimation.
Query Quality Defects: Queries cross-project defect counts (SIT, UAT, Production) and production defect leakage rate percentages.
Monthly Defect Trends: Analyzes monthly defect creation, resolution, and leakage trends across the portfolio.
Defect Root Cause Aggregation: Aggregates defect classification by root cause category (Coding, Requirement, Environment, Design).
Query Billing Overview: Queries revenue, resource costs, fixed costs, gross profit, and profit margin % across all projects.
Export Billing Sheet: Exports consolidated portfolio financial breakdown to CSV.
Profitability Forecast: Generates future profit margin projections based on planned sprint allocations and milestone schedules.
Query Billing Rates: Queries master resource rate directory, role benchmarks (avg billed rate, avg cost rate, avg margin %), and assigned rates.
Update Resource Rate: Updates daily billed rate and internal cost rate for an assigned resource in a project.
Update Specification Rate: Updates the daily billing rate on an impacted system or horizontal capability.
Bulk Update Rates: Batch updates daily billed and cost rates for multiple resources across projects.
Set Role Benchmarks: Sets standard organization baseline billed and cost rates for Developer, Tester, Architect, BA, and PM.
Query Available Resources: Searches for employees with available/free capacity (< 100% allocated across projects) filtered by role.
Create User: Adds a new team member/user to the workspace directory with email, role, and employee ID.
Update User Role: Modifies an existing user's organization role, department, or access level.
Activate/Deactivate User: Enables or disables user account login access.
List All Users: Retrieves the complete organization user directory with active project allocations.
Query Resource Utilization: Queries resource workload: active project allocations, availability %, planned task hours, actual logged hours, and over/under-allocation status.
Query Bench Resources: Searches team members with free allocation bandwidth (< 100%).
Query Overallocated Resources: Identifies team members allocated > 100% across multiple simultaneous active projects.
Department Utilization: Aggregates capacity utilization percentages grouped by department and skill set.
Export Utilization Report: Exports complete organization resource utilization sheet to CSV.
Query Holidays: Queries organization calendar holidays for the specified year.
Create Holiday: Adds a new holiday to the organization Holiday Calendar.
Delete Holiday: Deletes a holiday from the organization Holiday Calendar.
Bulk Import Holidays: Batch uploads a list of national/regional holidays from JSON or CSV.
Update Holiday: Modifies an existing holiday name, date, or category.
Query Leave Settings: Queries global leave policy quotas (allocated annual paid leaves, carryover limit, weekly off days).
Update Leave Settings: Updates organization leave quotas, carryover permissions, or weekly off days in Leave Settings.
Annual Leave Rollover: Executes year-end leave balance reset and applies carryover limit quotas for all employees.
Query Leave Requests: Queries employee leave requests and planned absences across the portfolio.
Apply Leave: Submits a leave request for an employee in Leave Tracker.
Cancel Leave: Cancels and deletes an employee leave record in Leave Tracker.
Approve Leave: Approves a pending employee leave request.
Reject Leave: Rejects a pending leave request with explanatory comments.
Check Leave Balance: Checks remaining paid leave balance and used leave days for a specific employee.
Bulk Update Specifications: Bulk sets the project summary, impacted systems, and horizontals in project specifications.
Add Impacted System: Adds an architectural component / module impacted by the project to specifications with estimation.
Add Horizontal: Adds a cross-cutting capability (e.g. QA & Testing, Architecture, DevOps) to project specifications.
Update Specification Rate: Updates the daily billing rate on an impacted system or horizontal capability.
Update Project Summary: Updates project summary and scope description in project specifications.
Edit Initial Impacted System: Updates an existing initial impacted system's name, description, category, or man-days estimate.
Delete Initial Impacted System: Deletes a specific impacted system from initial estimation specifications.
Edit Initial Horizontal: Updates an initial horizontal capability's name or weightage percentage.
Delete Initial Horizontal: Deletes a horizontal capability from initial estimation specifications.
Read Initial Specifications: Queries the current summary, list of initial impacted systems, horizontals, total dev effort/cost, and grand total effort/cost.
Confirm Estimation: Promotes initial estimation specifications to the active project plan and transitions project status.
Update Initial Status: Updates initial project status, pricing model (Fixed Bid / T&M), name, and description.
Assign Project Manager: Assigns or updates the primary Project Manager for the initial estimation phase.
Query Project Context: Queries initial estimation status, stories, and specifications context.
Set Estimation Timeline: Sets initial planned start date and end date with date sequence validation.
Read Initial Status: Returns key project metadata, PM assignment, pricing model, and estimation timeline.
Update Key Information: Updates project summary, scope description, pricing model, overall health status, or name.
Set Project Manager: Assigns or updates the primary Project Manager for the project.
Query Project Context: Queries project information: stories count, epics, sprints, risks, issues, environments, specifications.
Update Project Health: Updates individual Scope, Cost, Time, and Overall RAG health indicators and appends commentary to status history.
Set Project Timeline: Updates project start date and end date with date sequence validation.
Read Project Status & History: Retrieves full project key information, PM details, current RAG indicators, and complete status history audit log.
Add Fixed Cost: Adds a fixed financial cost item (software license, infrastructure, third-party API) to project finances.
Query Project Context: Queries high-level project statistics, active items, and sprints.
PM Dashboard Metrics: Retrieves release/sprint task distribution, epic progress %, and planned vs derived vs logged hours.
Resource Workload: Queries sub-task effort hours vs bug effort hours allocated to each team member filtered by sprint.
Resource Revenue & Cost: Computes project billing revenue vs internal cost broken down by role for Overall, Release, or Sprint timeframes.
Swim Lane Cycle Time: Returns total and average duration (in days) spent by items in each Kanban swim lane status.
Bottleneck Risk Analysis: Returns average cycle time per resource, active WIP counts, and bottleneck risk rankings (High, Medium, Low).
Epic Completion Progress: Returns list of all project Epics with completed stories count, total stories, and progress percentage.
Bulk Update Specifications: Bulk sets the project summary, impacted systems, and horizontals in project specifications.
Add Impacted System: Adds an architectural component / module impacted by the project to specifications with estimation.
Add Horizontal: Adds a cross-cutting capability (e.g. QA & Testing, Architecture, DevOps) to project specifications.
Update Specification Rate: Updates the daily billing rate on an impacted system or horizontal capability.
Add Environment: Adds an environment (Dev, SIT, UAT, Staging, Production) to project configurations.
Update Project Summary: Updates project executive summary in specifications.
Edit Impacted System: Updates an existing impacted system's name, description, category, or man-days estimate.
Delete Impacted System: Deletes a specific impacted system from project specifications.
Edit Horizontal: Updates an existing horizontal capability's name or weightage percentage.
Delete Horizontal: Deletes a horizontal capability from project specifications.
Read Specifications Breakdown: Queries the current summary, list of impacted systems, horizontals, total dev effort/cost, and grand total effort/cost.
Delete Environment: Deletes a testing/deployment environment from the project.
Reorder Environments: Updates the display order sequence of testing environments.
Assign Project Resource: Assigns an employee/resource to the project team with role and daily billing rate.
Query Resource Rates: Queries master resource rates and assigned project rates.
Update Resource Rate: Updates daily billed rate and internal cost rate for an assigned resource in a project.
Remove Project Resource: De-allocates and removes an employee from the project team.
Update Resource Role: Modifies an assigned team member's role (Developer, Tester, Architect, BA, PM) or allocation percentage.
List Project Resources: Retrieves all allocated project team members with onboarding dates and daily billing rates.
Log Work: Logs work hours against a user story or task for a specific date in timesheets.
Query Worklogs: Queries submitted timesheet entries for a project filtered by date range or employee.
Delete Worklog: Deletes an erroneous timesheet worklog entry.
Update Worklog: Modifies logged hours, description, or work type for an existing timesheet entry.
Query Resource Workload: Queries employee workload, availability %, planned task hours, and actual logged hours.
Project Workload Matrix: Returns full matrix of all project resources comparing capacity against planned task hours.
Reassign Task Workload: Reallocates work items or sub-tasks from an overloaded resource to an available team member.
Query Gantt Milestones: Queries project context, epics, sprints, and release milestones.
Gantt Timeline Data: Returns chronological project timeline with sprint dates, release milestones, and story schedules.
Set Task Predecessor: Creates start-to-finish predecessor dependency links between project timeline tasks.
Create Release: Creates a project Release, Stage, or Milestone in the project schedule.
Update Release: Modifies release start date, end date, milestone date, or status.
Delete Release: Deletes a release or milestone from the project schedule.
List Project Releases: Retrieves all project releases, stages, and milestones with schedule dates.
Assign Stories to Release: Associates user stories or defects with a specific project release.
Query Dev Context: Queries total stories, epics, and active sprint statistics.
Development Dashboard Metrics: Retrieves active sprint progress, sprint velocity points, and open defect counts.
Sprint Burndown Data: Fetches ideal vs actual remaining effort points across active sprint days.
Velocity Tracking: Computes completed story points per sprint across historical project sprints.
Create Work Item: Creates a new work item (User Story, Bug, Task, Feature Change, or Sub Task) with auto-generated sequential ID.
Create Epic: Creates a new Agile Epic in a project to group related user stories.
Create Sprint: Creates a new sprint timebox in a project.
Update Sprint: Updates sprint status (start sprint to Current, or Completed), goal, or dates.
Assign Story to Sprint: Assigns a work item (story, bug, task) to a sprint, or removes it to backlog.
Reorder Backlog: Updates the priority order ranking of user stories in the product backlog.
Delete Epic: Deletes an agile epic and unlinks its associated user stories.
Query Product Backlog: Returns all unassigned backlog stories filtered by epic, priority, or status.
Delete Work Item: Soft-deletes a work item, moving it to project trash.
Groom Story: Updates story estimation hours, acceptance criteria, title, and priority during grooming.
Bulk Estimate Stories: Applies story points or estimated hours to multiple backlog items simultaneously.
Query Ungroomed Stories: Filters backlog items that lack estimation hours or acceptance criteria.
Set Acceptance Criteria: Adds structured Gherkin (Given/When/Then) acceptance criteria to a story.
Create Kanban Item: Creates a story, task, or bug directly onto the Kanban board.
Move Kanban Card: Updates work item status column (To Do -> In Progress -> In QA -> Done).
Query Kanban Board: Retrieves all active work items grouped by their current Kanban column.
Configure WIP Limits: Sets maximum work-in-progress card limits for specific Kanban columns.
Create Sub-Task: Creates a sub-task (SUB-X) linked to a parent user story with estimated hours.
Update Sub-Task: Updates sub-task status, priority, description, or assigned developer.
Query Story Sub-Tasks: Retrieves all sub-tasks linked under a specified parent story ID.
Delete Sub-Task: Deletes a sub-task from a parent user story.
Bulk Create Sub-Tasks: Generates standard sub-tasks (Frontend, Backend, Unit Tests, Code Review) for a story in batch.
Log Defect: Creates a new Bug (BUG-X) with severity (Critical/High/Medium/Low) and priority.
Update Defect Status: Updates bug status (To Do, In Progress, In QA, Done) and resolution notes.
Query Defects: Lists all logged project bugs filtered by severity, status, or sprint.
Link Defect to Story: Associates a defect with the specific user story that introduced the regression.
Close Defect: Marks a defect as verified and closed with resolution summary.
Query Testing Context: Queries basic test cases and test cycle counts.
Test Dashboard Summary: Retrieves total test cases, execution pass/fail rates, and cycle completion status.
Test Execution Velocity: Returns test execution burn-up metrics across active test cycles.
Defect Density Metrics: Computes defect density per story and QA leakage rate to production.
Create Test Case: Creates a QA test case in a project with auto-generated TC-X sequential ID.
Bulk Generate Test Cases: Creates multiple QA test cases in a single batch operation with steps and expected results.
Edit Test Case: Updates test case title, step description, expected outcome, or type.
Delete Test Case: Soft-deletes a test case from the QA backlog.
Query Test Backlog: Retrieves all test cases in the project filtered by story ID or test type.
Bulk Import Test Suites: Imports test cases from structured CSV/JSON test repositories.
Create Test Cycle: Creates a QA test cycle or test plan (TP-X) on Dev, SIT, UAT, or Production.
Add Test Cases to Cycle: Adds existing project test cases into a specific Test Plan/Cycle for execution.
Update Test Cycle: Modifies test cycle dates, environment, or target release.
Delete Test Cycle: Deletes a test cycle and its execution run records.
List Test Cycles: Retrieves all test plans and cycles created in the project.
Remove Test Case from Cycle: Removes a test case from a specific test plan.
Record Test Execution: Updates the execution status of a test case in a cycle (Passed, Failed, Blocked, Skipped, Not Run) with effort hours.
Query Execution Run: Retrieves all test cases assigned to a test cycle with their current execution status.
Bulk Update Test Status: Batch marks multiple test cases as Passed or Skipped in a single action.
Log Defect from Test Run: Automatically creates a Bug linked directly to a failed test case execution.
Log QA Defect: Logs a defect identified during test execution with severity and reproduction steps.
Update QA Defect: Updates bug status following QA re-testing.
Query QA Defects: Queries defects logged during active test cycles filtered by environment (SIT, UAT).
Export Defects Report: Exports testing defects summary with severity and resolution notes to CSV.
Create RAID Item: Logs a governance item (Risk, Assumption, Issue, or Dependency) in the RAID log with RSK-X, ASM-X, ISS-X, or DEP-X ID.
Update RAID Item: Updates an existing RAID item (e.g. close an issue, update risk mitigation).
Query RAID Stats: Queries total counts of active risks, assumptions, issues, and dependencies.
RAID Summary: Retrieves executive breakdown of high-impact risks, open issues, unvalidated assumptions, and blocked dependencies.
Export RAID Log: Exports the complete project RAID register to CSV.
Log Risk: Creates a risk item (RSK-X) with severity (1-3), probability (1-3), and mitigation plan.
Update Risk Mitigation: Updates planned mitigation strategy, contingency plan, or risk status.
Query Project Risks: Returns all project risks ranked by risk score (Severity x Probability).
Delete Risk: Deletes a risk entry from the project RAID log.
Close Risk: Marks a risk as successfully mitigated and closed.
Log Assumption: Logs an assumption (ASM-X) with category (Technical, Resource, Business, External) and status (Active, Validated, Invalidated).
Update Assumption: Modifies assumption category or description.
Query Assumptions: Lists all active and validated project assumptions.
Delete Assumption: Deletes an assumption from the project RAID log.
Validate Assumption: Changes assumption status to Validated or Invalidated with validation notes.
Log Issue: Logs an active issue/blocker (ISS-X) with priority (Critical, High, Medium, Low) and status.
Update Issue Status: Updates issue status (Open, In Progress, Resolved, Closed).
Query Project Issues: Returns open project blockers filtered by priority.
Delete Issue: Deletes an issue entry from the project RAID log.
Resolve Issue: Marks a blocker as resolved with resolution details.
Log Dependency: Logs an internal/external dependency (DEP-X), dependent team/system, expected date, and status (On Track, At Risk, Blocked).
Update Dependency Status: Updates dependency progress, expected delivery date, or blocker notes.
Query Dependencies: Lists all project dependencies categorized by incoming/outgoing and tracking status.
Delete Dependency: Deletes a dependency entry from the project RAID log.
Set Dependency Status: Updates status to On Track, At Risk, or Blocked.
Query Project Holidays: Queries organization and project holidays for working day calculation.
Add Project Holiday: Adds an additional holiday to the calendar.
Toggle Holiday Override: Configures whether the project inherits global holidays or uses custom project holidays.
Query Custom Holidays: Retrieves project-specific holiday calendar overrides.
Query Team Absences: Queries planned leave requests of allocated project team members.
Submit Leave: Submits leave for a project resource.
Sprint Absence Overlay: Returns planned team absences overlapping with active sprint date ranges.
Link Code Repository: Links a GitHub, GitLab, or Bitbucket repository URL to the project.
Upload PMO Document: Uploads project charter, architecture diagram, SOW, or signoff deliverables.
Delete PMO Document: Deletes a document attachment from the project repository.
List Project Documents: Retrieves all uploaded project documents with upload dates and categories.
Add External Link: Links external SharePoint, Google Drive, or Confluence document URLs.
Query Fixed Bid Financials: Queries contract revenue, resource cost, fixed cost, and profit margin.
FB Billing Summary: Retrieves fixed bid contract value, billed amount, remaining unbilled balance, and billing schedule.
Update Contract Value: Updates total contracted fixed bid revenue amount.
Record FB Invoice: Logs an invoice raised against fixed bid milestones.
Create Payment Milestone: Creates a commercial payment milestone with billing percentage, amount, and status.
Update Payment Milestone: Updates milestone name, billing percentage, dollar amount, or status.
Delete Payment Milestone: Deletes a payment milestone from the commercial schedule.
List Payment Milestones: Returns all payment milestones with current billing status (TBD, In Progress, Milestone completed, Invoice raised, Payment Completed).
Raise Milestone Invoice: Transitions milestone status to Invoice raised with invoice reference number.
Query T&M Financials: Queries T&M total billed revenue, resource costs, and realized profit margin.
T&M Billing Summary: Retrieves monthly hours logged across all roles multiplied by daily billed rates.
Generate T&M Invoice: Calculates monthly billing invoice amount from approved timesheets.
Create T&M Milestone: Creates a T&M billing checkpoint milestone with target amount.
Update T&M Milestone: Modifies T&M billing milestone target amount or status.
Delete T&M Milestone: Deletes a T&M billing milestone.
List T&M Milestones: Retrieves all periodic T&M milestone checkpoints.
Query Project Governance Context: Queries team allocations and risk posture.
Query BCP Plan: Retrieves project business continuity plan, key role handovers, and emergency contact matrix.
Update BCP Handover: Configures primary and secondary successor backups for key project roles.
Update Disaster Recovery: Updates disaster recovery procedures, backup verification dates, and offsite contacts.
Add Kanban Column: Adds a custom workflow column (e.g. Code Review, Blocked) to the Kanban board.
Delete Kanban Column: Deletes a custom Kanban column from the project board.
Reorder Kanban Columns: Updates the sequence and order of Kanban workflow columns.
Query Board Settings: Retrieves all configured Kanban columns and workflow properties.
Set Sprint Duration: Configures default sprint duration in weeks (1, 2, 3, or 4 weeks).
Set Sprint Start Day: Configures default day of week for sprint start (Monday=1, Sunday=0).
Query Sprint Settings: Retrieves configured default sprint duration and start day.
Set Effort Conversion Factors: Updates project conversion units: manMonthToDays (22), manDayToHours (8), and storyPointToHours (8).
Query Effort Settings: Retrieves configured effort conversion ratios.
Query Project Trash: Lists deleted work items, test cases, and sprints in the project trash.
Restore Trash Item: Restores a soft-deleted work item or test case back to the active project.
Purge Trash Item: Permanently deletes an item from the project database.
Query Access Settings: Retrieves the complete role-permission matrix across all pages and CRUD scopes.
Configure Page Access: Grants or revokes page access permissions for specific roles (Senior Management, PM, Lead, Team Member, PMO).
Configure CRUD Access: Configures Create/Read/Update/Delete permissions for Portfolio, Project, Story, and Sub-task levels.
Reset Access Defaults: Restores all page and CRUD permissions to factory system defaults.
Check Database Health: Tests active database connection status (Firebase Firestore, Supabase, PostgreSQL).
Test Database Credentials: Tests connectivity against specified database host, port, and credentials.
Switch Database Provider: Configures active database provider between Firebase and Supabase/Postgres.
Check Auth Configuration: Queries active authentication provider (Firebase Auth, Keycloak SSO, Local Auth).
Configure Keycloak SSO: Configures Keycloak realm URL, client ID, and SSO callback endpoints.
Configure Firebase Auth: Configures Firebase authentication API keys and project settings.
Query AI Config: Queries active LLM provider (Google Gemini, OpenAI, Claude, LM Studio, Ollama) and loaded model.
Switch AI Provider: Switches active AI inference provider and model name.
Test AI Connection: Runs a test generation request to verify LLM endpoint connectivity and response latency.
Workspace Setup Wizard: Guided initialization of a new organization workspace, setting up root portfolios and initial settings.
Seed Demo Data: Populates the workspace with sample portfolios, benchmark rate cards, and holiday calendars.
Query Archived Projects: Retrieves detailed list of archived projects with archive timestamps and PM assignments.
Bulk Restore Projects: Restores multiple archived projects simultaneously.
Export Archive Log: Exports archived projects directory report to CSV.
Query Portfolio Trash: Lists all soft-deleted projects and portfolios currently in trash.
Restore Trash Project: Restores a soft-deleted project back to its parent portfolio.
Empty Portfolio Trash: Permanently purges all deleted projects and portfolios from the database.
